verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own pricing page lists Conversational Intelligence, which uses AI insights to understand calls and improve sales conversations. Its Agentic Voice AI platform also claims to analyze customer interactions end-to-end, so in-product AI insights from call data are a documented first-party capability. The evidence is only one-line marketing copy, and the feature appears to be an add-on rather than core functionality, so its depth is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights and suggestions are generated and over which data (beyond calls), how they surface in the app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
